2609.02264.title: Codebook Agent: Amortized Topology Design for LLM Multi-Agent Systems
2609.02264.paper_summary: Adapting the communication topology of an LLM multi-agent system to each query improves both accuracy and efficiency, yet current designers treat this as conditional graph generation: a variational, autoregressive, or diffusion decoder searches the $N \times N$ adjacency space, and a graph-network proxy trained on utility and a structural cost such as edge count ranks the sampled candidates. We argue that this formulation is misaligned with the problem. Empirically, topologies that survive a reward filter collapse to about six distinct graphs even when the codebook capacity grows from 8 to 64; edge count is negatively correlated with measured token consumption (Pearson $r \approx -0.4$), so sparsifying the graph makes inference more expensive; and a message-passing scorer over agent-profile nodes is adjacency-invariant whenever agents share a profile---the default configuration of published benchmarks---so it cannot rank candidates at all in that regime. These three facts motivate Codebook Agent: a vector-quantized autoencoder compresses successful topologies into a query-independent 16-entry codebook; a reward-weighted MLP maps the query embedding to a distribution over codes; and an MLP proxy that reads the flattened adjacency, regressed on measured utility and per-task normalized token cost, reranks the top decoded candidates in a single batched forward pass. With no iterative search and no message passing at test time, Codebook Agent is the most accurate method on all six benchmarks we compare (84.6 average against 83.0 for the strongest prior designer), emits a topology in 2.4 ms, and uses 21.9--33.2% fewer LLM tokens.
2609.02264.paper_summary_zh: 調整LLM多代理系統的通信拓撲以適應每個查詢，提高了準確性和效率，但目前的設計者將其視為條件圖生成：變分、自回歸或擴散解碼器在$N \times N$鄰接空間中搜索，而基於效用和結構成本（如邊數）訓練的圖網絡代理對樣本候選進行排名。我們認為這種表述與問題不符。根據實證，通過獎勵過濾器存活下來的拓撲在代碼本容量從8增長到64時仍然會崩潰到約六個不同的圖；邊數與測量的標記消耗呈負相關（Pearson $r \approx -0.4$），因此稀疏化圖形會使推理成本增加；而在代理共享配置文件的情況下，基於代理配置文件節點的消息傳遞計分器在鄰接性上是不變的——這是已發佈基準的默認配置——因此在該範疇內無法對候選進行排名。這三個事實促使了代碼本代理的出現：一個向量量化自編碼器將成功的拓撲壓縮成一個與查詢無關的16條目代碼本；一個獎勵加權的MLP將查詢嵌入映射到代碼的分佈；而一個讀取展平鄰接的MLP代理，基於測量的效用和每任務的標準化標記成本進行回歸，對前面解碼的候選進行重新排名，且僅需一次批量前向傳遞。在測試時無需迭代搜索和消息傳遞，代碼本代理在我們比較的所有六個基準中都是最準確的方法（平均84.6，強大的先前設計者為83.0），在2.4毫秒內發出一個拓撲，並使用21.9%至33.2%更少的LLM標記。
